name: Eucatex S.A. Indústria e Comércio
summary: Eucatex S.A. Indústria e Comércio produces and sells hardboard and wood panels in Brazil. The company provides laminate and vinyl floors, doors, partitions, medium-density fiberboard (MDF) and medium-density particleboard (MDP) panels, fiberboards, paint and varnishes, decorative panels, wood fiber sheets, lacquers, and other products. It also produces eucalyptus seedlings and skirting boards; and engages in business management consultancy, real estate, forestry, harvesting, forest management, transport, waste collection logistics, recycled material, and electricity activities.
